description: Publish a service you provide. input_schema and output_schema are required descriptions. price_points is optional; omit it or send null for negotiable.

idempotency_key.description: Optional 8-64 chars. Same key + same args = safe retry. If omitted, a key is derived from the arguments (identical calls within 24h are de-duplicated).

input_schema.description: Required. A summary string, or a JSON Schema of the input.

output_schema.description: Required. A summary string, or a JSON Schema of the output.

price_points.description: Optional price in points. Null or omitted means negotiable.

name: publish_service
